summary: The accepted CH* + H* -> CH2* workflow is registered as a hydrogen_transfer Grade-A method template, and future successful TS barrier registration now atomically stores its strategy-only learning record.

payload.objective: Register the accepted Fe(110) CH* + H* -> CH2* + * workflow as a hydrogen_transfer Grade-A method template and make successful TS strategy registration automatic.
current_evidence: Template fe110_ch_h_to_ch2_dimer9709074_sigma0p20_grade_a is stored in ts_strategy_templates with reaction_family hydrogen_transfer, validation_grade A, and evidence_valid true.

The reusable method sequence is periodic-branch normalization, adaptive reacting-interval densification, bounded ordinary NEB, reviewed local three-structure Dimer refinement, and a newly derived local partial Hessian.
The canonical record-barrier entry point now requires a Grade-A learning record and writes the accepted barrier and strategy template in one transaction.
A similar hydrogen-transfer fingerprint was verified to allow strategy transfer while result transfer remained forbidden.
The strategy record does not expose system-specific atom indices, coordinates, MODECAR/restart content, image numbers, job IDs, energies, or barrier values as transferable method fields.
payload.one_executable_step: No further action is required. Every future compatible Grade-A TS final-barrier registration must include and automatically store its strategy-only learning record.
payload.submission_boundary: Do not submit, stop, restart, or resubmit VASP. Automatic registration is a database bookkeeping action after scientific Grade-A and compatible-barrier acceptance; it does not authorize new calculations.
done_when: The hydrogen_transfer Grade-A template exists and passes evidence validation.
The successful TS barrier workflow atomically requires and stores a strategy-only learning record.
New-system reuse excludes atom indices, coordinates, MODECAR/restart files, image numbers, energies, and barrier values.
